assertion: white-space: pre preserves doubled spaces and the explicit line break, with a 32px line height and the same pinned Noto Sans font in every renderer.

browser.reason: The same pinned Noto Sans is used throughout. Chrome, Firefox and Valle agree on x=30, baselines 59/91 and line-height 32; WebKit baselines are 59.281494/91.281494 and remain diagnostic. Reviewed glyph-edge rasterization differs (Chrome 1807 pixels, max 130; Firefox 1808, max 130; WebKit 2002, max 168). Only a contour mask derived from the reviewed browser image permits these differences; flat regions and the border remain exact. Missing text, one-pixel glyph displacements and one-level solid-color changes must fail.
